2.mascotDialogue: Line 13's the whole strategy — instead of overwriting whoever's already in the bucket, the new node just points at her and becomes the new head. Nothing's ever lost to a collision.

4.mascotDialogue: The chain looks perfectly fine — one node, no dangling pointer in sight. That's the trap. The bug's not a broken pointer, mate, it's a silently vanished one — and this app shows 'lost node' plain as day, so she never hides.
